title: AcoustiPrint: Physics-Guided Neural Design of Manufacturable Acoustic Structures
abstract: arXiv:2610.30411v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work in additive manufacturing and neural inverse design enables the creation of complex three-dimensional structures to manipulate physical fields, yet these designs must also adhere to discrete, non-differentiable fabrication constraints. Current methods limit the design space by imposing differentiable soft manufacturability loss penalties, or by fixing structures through post-processing, causing a discrepancy between the geometry optimized by the physics model and the final fabricated result. Thus, we present AcoustiPrint, a physics-informed neural architecture for constrained inverse design that represents three-dimensional geometries with an implicit neural representation (INR) and passes each candidate through a printability operator before evaluating its final response. The printability operator executes layer-wise self-support, discrete material selection, and whole-body connectivity, assuring fabrication feasibility. To

translated_title: AcoustiPrint：物理引导的可制造声学结构神经设计
translated_abstract: 近年来，增材制造与神经逆设计的进展使得创建复杂三维结构来操控物理场成为可能，然而这些设计还必须遵守离散的、不可微分的制造约束。当前的方法通过施加可微分的软可制造性损失惩罚来限制设计空间，或通过后处理来固定结构，导致物理模型优化的几何形状与最终制造结果之间存在偏差。因此，我们提出了AcoustiPrint，这是一种用于约束逆设计的物理信息神经架构，它采用隐式神经表示（INR）来表示三维几何形状，并在评估最终响应之前让每个候选设计通过一个可打印性算子。该可打印性算子执行逐层自支撑、离散材料选择和整体连通性检查，从而确保制造可行性。
tldr: AcoustiPrint提出了一种物理信息神经架构，通过隐式神经表示三维几何并引入可打印性算子，在声学结构逆设计中确保优化结果直接满足增材制造的离散约束，弥合了物理优化几何与实际制造结果之间的差距。
en_tdlr: AcoustiPrint is a physics-informed neural architecture that represents 3D geometries with implicit neural representations and applies a printability operator, ensuring that acoustically optimized designs satisfy discrete manufacturing constraints and eliminating the gap between optimized geometry and fabricated results.
